mapper.select: select con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Party_B_Id as conPartyBId, pro.P_Name as pName, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, c1.C_Name as conPartyBName, c2.C_Name as eiSupervisorName, c3.C_Name as eiDesignName, c4.C_Name as eiContractorName, c5.C_Name as eiSupplierName, c1.C_Abbreviation as conPartyBAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as eiSupervisorAbbName, c3.C_Abbreviation as eiDesignAbbName, c4.C_Abbreviation as eiContractorAbbName, c5.C_Abbreviation as eiSupplierAbbName, ea.Ea_Code as eaCode, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Me_Enter_Inspection mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join Me_Enter_Apply ea on ea.Ea_Id=mn.Ea_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on con.Con_Party_B_Id=c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on mn.Ei_Supervisor_Id=c2.C_Id left join SYS_Company c3 on mn.Ei_Design_Id=c3.C_Id left join SYS_Company c4 on mn.Ei_Contractor_Id=c4.C_Id left join SYS_Company c5 on mn.Ei_Supplier_Id=c5.C_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Ei_Id where mn.Ei_Id=#{eiId}
